db5b18307286f697baa5723b04eae02e78f942ac.source: 分别管理服务器推荐与个人 PDF，筛选并勾选获取文献与内容更新，管理收藏夹，连续阅读原文、译文和解读，保存批注并导出副本。
db5b18307286f697baa5723b04eae02e78f942ac.translation: Manage server recommendations and personal PDFs separately; filter and select papers and content updates, organize collections, read originals, translations and commentary continuously, save annotations and export copies.

fb768f7846757f3ae665c07c0760a5fdc5dac9cb.source: 视频教程：<s id="0">观看本章视频</s>。
fb768f7846757f3ae665c07c0760a5fdc5dac9cb.translation: Video tutorial: <s id="0">watch this chapter's video</s>.

5b032bedb2f0d487cd0205259cb8cd1eca2f7aff.source: 从侧栏打开语音学论文精读。顶部选择服务器推荐或我的 PDF，左侧选论文，右侧阅读。推荐内容首次获取需要联网，已完整获取的文件可离线使用；自己的 PDF 从所选本地文件夹读取。右上角的帮助按钮打开本章，返回工具后可以继续阅读。
5b032bedb2f0d487cd0205259cb8cd1eca2f7aff.translation: Open Phonetics paper reader from the sidebar. Choose Server recommendations or My PDFs at the top, select a paper on the left and read on the right. Recommendations need a connection for initial download; fully downloaded files work offline. Personal PDFs are read from the selected local folder. Help at the upper right opens this chapter; returning to the tool resumes reading.

5f1b16e36cf88dc49f2eb3f665e0a93ec9ae5c72.source: 服务器推荐：查看栏目提供的原文、中文译文和已提供的独立论文解读，设置自动获取或手动选取往期。推荐文件保存在应用的数据目录。
5f1b16e36cf88dc49f2eb3f665e0a93ec9ae5c72.translation: Server recommendations: view supplied originals, Chinese translations and available independent commentary. Set automatic downloads or select past papers manually. Files stay in the application's data directory.

06e5e03a352a95a134088b8e8714d5664e7000b3.source: 我的 PDF：选择自己的论文根文件夹、复制导入 PDF，并用真实子文件夹整理。个人文件保存在所选位置，不上传服务器。
06e5e03a352a95a134088b8e8714d5664e7000b3.translation: My PDFs: choose a library root, copy PDFs into it and organize them in actual subfolders. Personal files stay at the selected location and are not uploaded.

1475663c448f7a1ee3d37d8304d85630325389f1.source: 两个来源的目录与收藏夹独立管理，共用连续阅读、选字、批注和导出工具。切换来源后，题名搜索、年月与收藏夹筛选回到全部范围。拖动论文库与阅读区之间的边界可调整左栏宽度，放开后自动保存；切换来源或工作台标签继续沿用，窗口临时变窄不会覆盖保存的宽度。
1475663c448f7a1ee3d37d8304d85630325389f1.translation: The two sources have separate catalogs and collections but share continuous reading, text selection, annotation and export. Switching source resets title, year/month and collection filters to all. Drag the divider to resize the library panel; releasing saves the width. Source/tab switches retain it, and temporary narrow windows do not overwrite the saved width.

357e4973c1b31bd240f5edaeb5693a09d7e4ed32.source: 服务器推荐目录顶部的请看这里~是本栏目的使用说明，单独置顶显示，不计入论文数量。点击可阅读。可在这行上点击鼠标右键，选择删除本机副本并确认。删除后重启或检查更新均不会重新获取，批注保留；需要时从获取往期中勾选请看这里~重新获取。关闭自动获取时，应用启动仍会检查并取得尚未删除的说明，论文不会因此在后台获取。
357e4973c1b31bd240f5edaeb5693a09d7e4ed32.translation: 请看这里~ at the top of the recommendations is this column's guide, pinned separately and excluded from paper counts. Click to read. Right-click its row, choose Delete local copy and confirm to remove it; annotations remain, and startup/update checks do not restore it. Select 请看这里~ under Past papers to retrieve it again. Even with automatic download off, startup checks and retrieves undeleted notices without downloading papers in the background.

7c40821446f9ca7a1cb9f8492251dad4e8e84bc3.source: 在目录上方输入题名关键词。推荐论文可匹配中英文题名，个人文件按去掉 .pdf 后的文件名显示与搜索。
7c40821446f9ca7a1cb9f8492251dad4e8e84bc3.translation: Enter title keywords above the catalog. Recommendations match Chinese and English titles; personal PDFs display and search filenames without .pdf.

4f9a9e918d99dd49884eda1401599791bbf77efc.source: 选择年份，再按需要选择月份；也可保持全部年份、全部月份。推荐目录按栏目发布日期筛选，个人目录按文件修改日期筛选。论文发表年月需查看原文。
4f9a9e918d99dd49884eda1401599791bbf77efc.translation: Choose a year and optionally a month, or leave All years/All months. Recommendations filter by column release date; personal files by modification date. Check the paper itself for publication dates.

c35d2d49e6f720150dcd33062ce4f6f977e2c461.source: 选择收藏夹，只查看其中的条目；恢复全部推荐或全部文件可显示所有收藏夹的内容。每篇题名单行显示，长题名省略，鼠标停在条目上可查看完整题名。
c35d2d49e6f720150dcd33062ce4f6f977e2c461.translation: Choose a collection to show its entries. All recommendations/All files shows every collection. Titles occupy one row and truncate when long; hover for the full title.

4c9ec041f1ff1448e40879d71632874c6b1e6c83.source: 点击题名打开。推荐条目若尚未获取，右侧显示仅获取这篇论文；点击后等待完成，再开始阅读。筛选结果为空时，先检查关键词、年月与收藏夹范围。
4c9ec041f1ff1448e40879d71632874c6b1e6c83.translation: Click a title to open it. Undownloaded recommendations show Download this paper only on the right; wait for completion before reading. For empty results, check keywords, dates and collection.

d55d6059f59340b0511ae6f41a1741c0861e7e45.source: 点击右侧题名栏的论文信息可以展开或收起详情。推荐论文显示完整中英文题名、作者、原稿日期、固定版本、许可、翻译说明和阅读导引；个人 PDF 显示文件名、大小及本地来源。
d55d6059f59340b0511ae6f41a1741c0861e7e45.translation: Paper information beside the title expands or collapses details. Recommendations show full bilingual titles, authors, original date, fixed version, license, translation notes and reading guide. Personal PDFs show filename, size and local source.

9ed94a799c5e4840dd4bf57f0b1661d0ea31e4e4.source: 服务器推荐采用单行目录，与个人 PDF 分开；缩放菜单保留适宽，顶部提供自动获取设置。
9ed94a799c5e4840dd4bf57f0b1661d0ea31e4e4.translation: Recommendations use a single-line catalog separate from personal PDFs. Zoom retains Fit width, and automatic-download controls sit at the top.

13a34aebb29615500e5408b999e43b69fc0b0fe0.source: 软件首次启动包含论文精读能力的版本时记录日期。默认获取该日期当日及之后在栏目发布的推荐，升级不会重置起点。推荐目录中的日期是栏目发布日期，论文原稿日期在展开的信息区查看。
13a34aebb29615500e5408b999e43b69fc0b0fe0.translation: The first launch of a version with paper-reading support records a date. Default downloads cover recommendations released on or after that date; upgrades do not reset it. Catalog dates are column release dates. View original manuscript dates in expanded information.

c3632ba51f9cecc15834517559f3fefc1e3887f6.source: 每次应用启动检查一次，持续运行时定时检查并获取新论文。
c3632ba51f9cecc15834517559f3fefc1e3887f6.translation: Checks once at each startup, then periodically checks and downloads new papers while the application remains running.

81178a58be51caa0fbc7145bd50f0025ae077114.source: 默认 6 小时，允许 0.25 至 720 小时

1c7f0c73e41770f80403f88d71426f15a2d6f7c2.source: 点击顶部的小时数，输入间隔后选择保存间隔。修改会调整下一次定时检查。
1c7f0c73e41770f80403f88d71426f15a2d6f7c2.translation: Click the hour value, enter an interval and Save interval. Changes reschedule the next check.

2aed5fbd4e95443d2cf9c9a99eb8fa6368608acd.source: 停止论文的定时检查与自动获取，仍可手动检查或获取往期；应用启动仍会检查并取得尚未删除的栏目说明。
2aed5fbd4e95443d2cf9c9a99eb8fa6368608acd.translation: Stops timed checks and automatic paper downloads; manual checks and past-paper retrieval remain available. Startup still checks and retrieves undeleted notices.

938dbbbfadfe11e963c0239474fbca0c1920057e.source: 联网更新目录，获取默认起点当日及之后的新推荐，并补齐已有论文的可用内容更新。
938dbbbfadfe11e963c0239474fbca0c1920057e.translation: Refreshes the online catalog, downloads new recommendations from the default start date onward and retrieves available updates to existing papers.

ac2c1added9d88b10852416f3568dec498b2d081.source: 定时检查由应用负责，无须把论文模块一直留在前台。点击小时数打开设置后，输入允许范围内的数值再保存；范围无效时窗口显示错误，应修改后重试。点击取消不保存输入。
ac2c1added9d88b10852416f3568dec498b2d081.translation: The application manages scheduled checks; the reader need not stay foreground. Open interval settings via the hour value, enter a valid value and save. Invalid ranges show an error; correct and retry. Cancel discards the input.

f31bb9aec109c7bb3b994ac99e3f068eebda6aea.source: 需要立即检查时，点击检查新论文。界面显示获取进度，完成后按结果提示已获取 X 篇新论文、已更新 Y 篇已有论文的内容，X 和 Y 为本次数量。没有待获取内容时显示服务器目录共 N 篇，本次检查无需下载，N 为目录篇数。网络失败时核对原因并稍后重试，现有有效目录与文件保留。关闭自动获取时，手动检查仍能获取新论文与可用内容更新。
f31bb9aec109c7bb3b994ac99e3f068eebda6aea.translation: For an immediate check, click Check for new papers. Progress is shown; completion reports X new papers and Y existing papers updated, where X/Y are this run's counts. With nothing to retrieve, it shows N papers in the server catalog and no download needed, where N is the catalog total. Network failure retains valid catalogs/files; check the cause and retry later. Manual checks retrieve new papers and updates even with automatic download off.

0d380792f1741a6b18cccec4c3599e98e519c82b.source: 自动获取开启时应用启动检查一次，可修改持续运行期间的检查间隔。此例保存为 12 小时。
0d380792f1741a6b18cccec4c3599e98e519c82b.translation: With automatic download enabled, startup checks once; change the interval for continued operation. This example saves 12 hours.

671b186508a411b89c7941721d3ed15a9cb8e4ac.source: 推荐条目可以在首次收录后补充全文译文、独立解读或修订文件。检查时既关注新收录，也关注已有条目的内容更新；同一论文沿用原条目，已获取的有效文件会跳过，仅获取缺失或变化的文件。
671b186508a411b89c7941721d3ed15a9cb8e4ac.translation: Recommendations may later gain full translations, commentary or revised files. Checks cover both new entries and updates. The same paper keeps its entry; valid downloaded files are skipped and only missing/changed files are obtained.

1b0d0732bd6f0e12ead13697bec4d2dd2f695b13.source: 原文和译文已在本机而解读尚未获取时，可以先阅读原译文，再通过检查新论文或该条目的获取入口补齐解读。缺失文件的获取失败时，查看提示后重试；原文件仍可使用。更新后的 PDF 内容与旧版不同，批注记录按旧文件内容保留，不自动迁移到新版本。
1b0d0732bd6f0e12ead13697bec4d2dd2f695b13.translation: If original/translation files are present but commentary is not, read them first and obtain commentary via Check for new papers or the entry's download. Failed retrieval can be retried while existing files remain usable. When PDF content changes, annotations stay with the old content and are not migrated automatically.

842296bfc35133cbf10aa62886d4280c2c94ed5b.source: 检查新论文用于获取原文、译文与解读的内容更新。新控件和功能通过软件更新入口升级；栏目新增或补充文献通常无须重新安装应用。
842296bfc35133cbf10aa62886d4280c2c94ed5b.translation: Check for new papers retrieves updates to originals, translations and commentary. New application features use software updates; new or supplemented papers usually need no application reinstall.

f3698639c6decfba672bdfb0bef0d1f205911374.source: 检查完成后显示服务器目录篇数。本例两篇已经完整获取，因此无需再次下载。
f3698639c6decfba672bdfb0bef0d1f205911374.translation: The completed check shows the catalog total. Both papers in this example are already complete, so no further download is needed.

e472d8fe44aba2d4b08afa626be61bd8a908f250.source: 点击服务器推荐右上角的获取往期。窗口会联网更新目录，左侧列出年份，展开所选年份可选月份；全部年份可显示整个往期范围。
e472d8fe44aba2d4b08afa626be61bd8a908f250.translation: Click Past papers at the upper right of recommendations. The dialog refreshes the online catalog and lists years on the left. Expand a year to select months; All years shows the whole range.

9ba0522cb1eb7dc451b35156ae3f8005d5708ed8.source: 在右侧核对中英文题名。将鼠标停在题名上，或让题名获得键盘焦点，可查看中文摘要和英文摘要；未提供摘要时显示相应提示。
9ba0522cb1eb7dc451b35156ae3f8005d5708ed8.translation: Check Chinese/English titles on the right. Hover or focus a title for both abstracts; unavailable abstracts show a notice.

926130ac6fa2e627e98a94ad77d08f1db7a6ecfb.source: 逐篇勾选想读的论文，或使用全选当前筛选，勾选当前年份或月份内尚未获取的条目。切换月份时已有勾选保留，其他月份的选择不会被当前筛选全选替换。
926130ac6fa2e627e98a94ad77d08f1db7a6ecfb.translation: Select papers individually or use Select all in current filter for undownloaded entries in the chosen year/month. Switching months retains selections elsewhere; selecting all affects only the current range.

ccc58b9868a94cb88edfca393f7a802b2d4d2652.source: 查看窗口底部的已选篇数与预计大小，再点击获取已选。该按钮只获取已勾选论文，大小包含目录中提供的原文、译文及独立解读文件。
ccc58b9868a94cb88edfca393f7a802b2d4d2652.translation: Review the selected count and estimated size at the bottom, then Download selected. Only checked papers are retrieved; size includes supplied originals, translations and commentary.

5ce98cf48a4d65ce15feb923b0b003bcc7fc83cf.source: 等待完成后关闭窗口。获取中可点击取消下载，已完成的有效文件保留；失败或取消后可重新勾选未完整获取的论文再获取。往期选择不会改变首次日期。
5ce98cf48a4d65ce15feb923b0b003bcc7fc83cf.translation: Close after completion. Cancel download retains completed valid files. After failure/cancellation, reselect incomplete papers to retry. Past-paper selection does not change the initial date.

980d5ae7a2d09631b9a760e7348a98b5740898f1.source: 已获取论文默认隐藏。勾选显示已获取可查看当前筛选内的已获取题名，这些条目的选择框禁用，不能重复勾选。未获取列表为空时，可以切换年月范围或查看已获取内容。
980d5ae7a2d09631b9a760e7348a98b5740898f1.translation: Downloaded papers are hidden by default. Show downloaded reveals them in the filter, with disabled checkboxes to prevent re-selection. For empty undownloaded lists, change dates or show downloaded items.

e391416a18166d94f7704f94cfbe921a03ebd700.source: 往期左侧选择年份、月份，右侧勾选双语题名，只获取已选论文；已获取项默认隐藏。
e391416a18166d94f7704f94cfbe921a03ebd700.translation: Choose year/month on the left and bilingual titles on the right. Only selections download; completed entries are hidden by default.

c14c162f44b032cff9bc8581ee7407e708d6b89d.source: 建立自己的 PDF 库

63a593a1a4a8e890644230cc30e07bedc52ed2cf.source: 切换到我的 PDF，点击选择论文文件夹，在系统文件夹窗口选择一个已有文件夹。该文件夹作为本地库的根位置，宜选择与应用推荐文件目录分开的独立位置。
63a593a1a4a8e890644230cc30e07bedc52ed2cf.translation: Switch to My PDFs and Choose paper folder, then select an existing folder in the system dialog. This becomes the local library root; choose a separate location from the application's recommendation files.

b7c5b816c3077bbeb5ce8c9f53bfca78a3770626.source: 选择后，左栏列出根文件夹及普通子文件夹中的 PDF，底部显示当前根位置。已有 PDF 可以直接点击阅读，无须再次导入。
b7c5b816c3077bbeb5ce8c9f53bfca78a3770626.translation: The left panel lists PDFs in the root and ordinary subfolders; the bottom shows the root location. Read existing PDFs directly without importing again.

6f0aeb19010b40540890a2391ad6d2ea6aed2a8c.source: 以后点击更换文件夹可选择另一个根位置。此操作切换正在浏览的库，不搬走原库文件；再次选回原位置可继续使用。
6f0aeb19010b40540890a2391ad6d2ea6aed2a8c.translation: Change folder chooses another root. It changes the displayed library without moving files; choose the old location again to return.

f0befc84b6aae4767428a45bdd612ad1557a98e4.source: 取消文件夹窗口会保留原选择。根位置不存在、与应用论文目录重叠，或包含符号链接、联接时会显示错误，请重新选择普通文件夹。扫描库时不进入链接目录及名称以点开头的子文件夹。
f0befc84b6aae4767428a45bdd612ad1557a98e4.translation: Cancelling retains the previous selection. Missing roots, overlap with the application's paper directory, or symbolic links/junctions produce an error; choose an ordinary folder. Scans skip linked directories and dot-prefixed subfolders.

6f80bd0c52bd11ee70ca998d42fccd8bfd3e0934.source: 先选择论文根文件夹，再点击导入 PDF。在导入窗口的存入下拉选择根文件夹或一个已有收藏夹。
6f80bd0c52bd11ee70ca998d42fccd8bfd3e0934.translation: Choose the library root, then Import PDF. In Save in, choose the root or an existing collection.

90d8695768fa080b37a44d12fe541f4d19f86112.source: 点击选择 PDF，在系统文件窗口中选择一份或多份 PDF。确认后，应用把文件复制到所选位置，导入来源保留。
90d8695768fa080b37a44d12fe541f4d19f86112.translation: Click Choose PDFs and select files in the system dialog. Confirmation copies them to the selected location, retaining originals.

662a12110831ce7a3278b99a78a12870d15a2f34.source: 完成后查看已导入篇数，目录会显示成功导入的文件。若有文件失败，核对提示中的文件名与原因，成功文件仍留在库中。
662a12110831ce7a3278b99a78a12870d15a2f34.translation: Check the imported count; successful files appear in the catalog. For failures, inspect filenames and causes in the notice. Successful files remain in the library.

98d0e4f12fc9cf8991d8ab6307ef8434e6f9e689.source: 当前导入接受不超过 200 MB、1 至 1000 页且未加密的有效 PDF。目标存在同名文件时不会覆盖；可在来源位置为待导入副本改名，或选择其他收藏夹后重试。取消系统文件窗口不导入文件。扫描 PDF 可以导入并阅读，页面文字选择仍取决于文件是否有内嵌文本层。
98d0e4f12fc9cf8991d8ab6307ef8434e6f9e689.translation: Imports accept valid, unencrypted PDFs up to 200 MB and 1–1000 pages. Existing same-name files are not overwritten; rename the import copy or choose another collection and retry. Cancelling the system dialog imports nothing. Scanned PDFs can be read, but text selection depends on an embedded text layer.

bcaf5999186087681c7f7ef8d5be5b8dbad68fdb.source: 在我的 PDF 中导入麦耘论文及 extIPA 文件副本，目录与服务器推荐独立。
bcaf5999186087681c7f7ef8d5be5b8dbad68fdb.translation: Import copies of Mai Yun's paper and extIPA files in My PDFs; its catalog remains separate from recommendations.

e7f476ffe97e959a85ca81574539a805e61e58d2.source: 点击目录收藏夹筛选旁的 ＋，输入普通文件夹名称，再点击创建。我的 PDF 会在根下建立同名子文件夹。已有子文件夹也会出现在收藏夹列表中。
e7f476ffe97e959a85ca81574539a805e61e58d2.translation: Click ＋ beside the collection filter, enter an ordinary folder name and Create. My PDFs creates a matching subfolder under the root; existing subfolders also appear as collections.

22620b32eab3773c8fceb30cc9a92576a7e94019.source: 选中一份 PDF，点击题名栏右侧的移至收藏夹，选择目标后点击确定。应用移动库内的实际 PDF，导入来源文件保留。选择根文件夹可把库内文件移回根位置。
22620b32eab3773c8fceb30cc9a92576a7e94019.translation: Select a PDF, click Move to collection beside its title, choose a destination and confirm. This moves the actual library PDF, retaining the original import source. Choose Root folder to move it back.

fa7d3cb585513356aae242060689b55f72456397.source: 整理后用收藏夹筛选查看结果。文件内容未改变时，已有批注继续可用。目标已有同名 PDF 时会提示未覆盖，可选择其他收藏夹或先在文件管理器中调整名称。
fa7d3cb585513356aae242060689b55f72456397.translation: Filter by collection to inspect the result. Existing annotations remain when content is unchanged. Same-name destination files prevent overwriting; choose another collection or rename in a file manager first.

d5e6118ba1f55d26c3526c4c68f1ecdced23210f.source: 在文件管理器中移动、改名或新增 PDF 后，回到我的 PDF 点击刷新，使目录与磁盘文件一致。文件被外部移动或删除导致读取失败时，先刷新并重新选择条目。备份和恢复时，保留整个根文件夹及其子文件夹结构。
d5e6118ba1f55d26c3526c4c68f1ecdced23210f.translation: After external moves, renames or additions, Refresh My PDFs to rescan. For missing/moved files, refresh and reselect. Back up and restore the full root with its subfolder structure.

eaee3847eb3b900fbc3d3db0ac971e6268f75f4a.source: 收藏夹对应本地真实子文件夹，移至方言元音后可按收藏夹筛选，原导入来源保留。
eaee3847eb3b900fbc3d3db0ac971e6268f75f4a.translation: Collections correspond to actual local subfolders. After moving to 方言元音, filter by that folder; the original import source remains.

9ec6cefcc61249b63fcc0bb56f632e1fc478c2a9.source: 在服务器推荐中也可通过 ＋ 创建收藏夹，再选中论文点击收藏，选择目标并确定。推荐收藏夹仅保存本机标签分组，选择未收藏可移出分组；此操作不创建个人库子文件夹，也不移动推荐 PDF。相同名称的推荐收藏夹和个人收藏夹彼此独立。
9ec6cefcc61249b63fcc0bb56f632e1fc478c2a9.translation: In recommendations, create collections with ＋, select a paper, choose Add to collection and confirm. These are local label groups; Unfiled removes grouping. They do not create personal-library subfolders or move recommendation PDFs. Same-named collections in the two sources are independent.

2fd2ca52f2ef722ad1ff163351c5b4747a4d2c7d.source: 删除收藏夹并保留内容
2fd2ca52f2ef722ad1ff163351c5b4747a4d2c7d.translation: Delete a collection and keep contents

2c0cc6252cd7f020b8b3e417364c702e0498c4e8.source: 在左侧收藏夹筛选中选定一个具体收藏夹，再点击下拉旁的垃圾桶图标，鼠标提示为删除收藏夹。未选具体收藏夹时按钮禁用，全部范围、未收藏与个人根文件夹不能删除。
2c0cc6252cd7f020b8b3e417364c702e0498c4e8.translation: Select a specific collection, then click the trash icon beside the filter, whose tooltip is Delete collection. Without a specific collection it is disabled; All, Unfiled and the personal root cannot be deleted.

0944b60553c94dacce52d7a1afe0788157c38e10.source: 在确认窗口核对收藏夹名称与当前来源。服务器推荐删除本机分类，原分类中的论文回到未收藏，已获取文件和批注保留。我的 PDF 先将收藏夹内的所有文件及子文件夹移到上一级，完成后移除空收藏夹。
0944b60553c94dacce52d7a1afe0788157c38e10.translation: Check the collection name and source in the confirmation. Recommendations remove the local category, returning papers to Unfiled while retaining downloads/annotations. My PDFs first moves all contents up one level, then removes the empty folder.

6dc941e2e2f37f56defdd401ad451fa1389dd8ee.source: 核对后点击删除收藏夹并保留文件。完成后重新查看未收藏、上一级收藏夹或全部范围，确认条目与文件仍可阅读。个人 PDF 的内容未改变时，批注继续可用；点击取消保留原分类与文件位置。
6dc941e2e2f37f56defdd401ad451fa1389dd8ee.translation: Click Delete collection and keep files. Check Unfiled, the parent or All and confirm the files still read. Unchanged personal PDFs retain annotations. Cancel keeps classification and locations.

08ea0dfaccffe1b35db501768d2f333db6e8c08d.source: 个人收藏夹的上一级已有同名文件或子文件夹时，操作整批停止，不覆盖、不合并。按错误提示核对冲突项，在文件管理器中调整名称或位置，回到模块刷新后再重新选择收藏夹并确认。此操作会搬出所有类型的文件，不能仅凭左栏 PDF 数量判断文件夹为空。
08ea0dfaccffe1b35db501768d2f333db6e8c08d.translation: If the parent already has a matching file/subfolder name, the entire operation stops without overwriting or merging. Resolve names/locations in a file manager, refresh and confirm again. All file types move; the PDF count alone cannot establish an empty folder.

c0a8aeabdbc573a5a1c4d3ed2e0eb177c72ccfd8.source: 个人根文件夹不可删除。包含符号链接、联接或越界路径时会提示错误，请先在文件管理器中整理。文件占用或权限导致移动失败时，应用尝试恢复原位置；若提示部分文件留在上一级，应刷新后检查原收藏夹及上一级两个位置，再处理占用或权限。确认两个位置的文件均可读取后再继续整理。
c0a8aeabdbc573a5a1c4d3ed2e0eb177c72ccfd8.translation: The personal root cannot be deleted. Symbolic links, junctions or out-of-bounds paths cause errors; organize them externally. On busy-file/permission failures, restoration is attempted. If some files remain in the parent, refresh and inspect both locations, resolve access issues and confirm all files are readable before continuing.

087106240c926bc6965ccaa41f22a171afd680a8.source: 删除服务器推荐收藏夹前核对说明，论文回到未收藏，已获取文件与批注保留。
087106240c926bc6965ccaa41f22a171afd680a8.translation: Confirm before deleting a recommendation collection. Papers return to Unfiled; downloaded files and annotations remain.

f15bc4fe1835f51ccefb3c32ec55836ad2f228fe.source: 删除本地收藏夹时，内部所有文件和子文件夹移到上一级，不删除PDF。
f15bc4fe1835f51ccefb3c32ec55836ad2f228fe.translation: Deleting a local collection moves all files and subfolders up one level; PDFs are not deleted.

59da5689571ab71aaa319ced49a25351119c7704.source: 上一级存在同名项目时整批停止，文件未移动、收藏夹未删除，处理重名后可重试。
59da5689571ab71aaa319ced49a25351119c7704.translation: Same-name parent entries stop the whole operation: no files move and no collection is deleted. Resolve names and retry.

313a63fb67ecbf9afae5d9842a51b32a8544b5b8.source: 删除完成后原PDF继续打开，文件与内部子文件夹保留在上一级。
313a63fb67ecbf9afae5d9842a51b32a8544b5b8.translation: After deletion, the PDF still opens; its files and nested folders remain in the parent.

b070be97894d10b8d11079ca192722048c4d548a.source: 在服务器推荐的论文行上点击鼠标右键，选择删除本机副本。在确认窗口核对题名，再点击删除本机副本。已获取的原文、译文和解读被清除，批注保留，条目从推荐目录隐藏。自动检查不会重新获取这篇论文；需要恢复时，在获取往期中重新勾选并获取。
b070be97894d10b8d11079ca192722048c4d548a.translation: Right-click a recommendation and choose Delete local copy. Check its title and confirm. Downloaded originals, translations and commentary are removed; annotations remain and the entry is hidden. Automatic checks will not retrieve it. Restore it by selecting it again in Past papers.

7e903780ef128eb316cf4d42b3b6fe127885238e.source: 在我的 PDF 的文件行上点击鼠标右键，选择移入回收站。核对题名后确认，库内实际 PDF 将进入系统回收站，导入前的来源文件与本机批注保留。点击取消保留文件原位。
7e903780ef128eb316cf4d42b3b6fe127885238e.translation: Right-click a My PDFs file and choose Move to trash. After title confirmation, the actual library PDF goes to system trash; the original import source and annotations remain. Cancel keeps the file in place.

c7abe40de9593d263b5a508ac72952f762b7de17.source: 回收站不可用或文件被其他窗口占用时，会提示失败并保留文件，不会改为永久删除。可关闭其他阅读窗口后重试；从系统回收站恢复文件后，回到我的 PDF 点击刷新，再选择恢复的文件。
c7abe40de9593d263b5a508ac72952f762b7de17.translation: If trash is unavailable or the file is busy, failure retains the file rather than deleting permanently. Close other readers and retry. After restoring from system trash, refresh My PDFs and select it.

1733da7c04fcbd4e19068ec8c0a794d306849d6d.source: 在服务器推荐左栏点击论文，再展开论文信息。阅读导引用于了解研究问题、方法、关键图表和结论边界；需要正文空间时再收起信息。
1733da7c04fcbd4e19068ec8c0a794d306849d6d.translation: Select a recommendation and expand Paper information. The guide introduces questions, methods, key figures and claim boundaries; collapse it when more reading space is needed.

be92a4c260ca167c2ce27dc306a960a1b5a39ad8.source: 若信息区提供解读与方法分析，可以展开阅读简短分析。若阅读器提供论文解读标签，可点击打开独立解读 PDF，与原文、中文译文使用同一阅读器。
be92a4c260ca167c2ce27dc306a960a1b5a39ad8.translation: Expand Interpretation and methods analysis for a brief discussion when available. A Paper commentary tab opens the separate commentary PDF in the same reader as original/translation.

29dc86c5e2f624ce31cb0b4d732f78d07a0ea815.source: 分别查看原文中的实验条件、图表和结果，再对照译文及解读。三份文档各自分页，不按页码自动对齐。
29dc86c5e2f624ce31cb0b4d732f78d07a0ea815.translation: Inspect original experimental conditions, figures and results, then compare translation and commentary. Each document paginates independently; page numbers do not synchronize automatically.

06e1db5a2ad48e20c21674afd6cb6274a3332d66.source: 示例论文为 Articulatory Source-Filter TTS: Physically Grounded Control through Vocal Tract Kinematics，固定版本为 arXiv:2610.00735v1。译文和解读辅助理解，原文的实验条件、统计分母及结论边界仍应单独核对。个人 PDF 不自动生成中文译文、导读或独立解读。
06e1db5a2ad48e20c21674afd6cb6274a3332d66.translation: The example is Articulatory Source-Filter TTS: Physically Grounded Control through Vocal Tract Kinematics, fixed at arXiv:2610.00735v1. Translation/commentary aid understanding; verify experimental conditions, statistical denominators and claim limits in the original. Personal PDFs do not receive automatic Chinese translation, guides or commentary.

2f71aa59e04fd1b74eda1cb402c807c9516fc626.source: 栏目第二篇为《基于音素到构音模型的协同发音定量分析》（Towards a Quantitative Analysis of Coarticulation with a Phoneme-to-Articulatory Model），固定版本为 arXiv:2408.05641v1。原稿在 arXiv 的提交日期为 2024-08-10，栏目新收录日期为 2026-10-10。栏目日期记录收录时间，原稿日期记录论文提交时间。原文、全文译文和独立解读共用前述阅读流程。<s id="0"> 原文固定版本页面</s>
2f71aa59e04fd1b74eda1cb402c807c9516fc626.translation: The second paper is Towards a Quantitative Analysis of Coarticulation with a Phoneme-to-Articulatory Model, fixed at arXiv:2408.05641v1. Its arXiv submission date is 2024-08-10; column acquisition date is 2026-10-10. These respectively record manuscript submission and column inclusion. Original, full translation and commentary share the workflow above. <s id="0">Fixed original version</s>

16a0b3d3b5ac3e6b022a66bdda8906c1b246ced5.source: 展开论文信息，查看双语题名、作者、固定版本、许可、翻译说明和阅读导引。
16a0b3d3b5ac3e6b022a66bdda8906c1b246ced5.translation: Expand Paper information to view bilingual titles, authors, fixed version, license, translation notes and reading guide.

33cd132c4c1e9e7582a8989fec1116e8063ba9b5.source: 独立论文解读使用同一阅读器，分析与原论文结果分别标明。
33cd132c4c1e9e7582a8989fec1116e8063ba9b5.translation: Independent commentary uses the same reader; its analysis is identified separately from original results.

df7a1addbf168810f9e3bad437cd979a72684bf1.source: 第二篇推荐显示原稿2024年日期、固定版本和CC BY 4.0许可，栏目2026年新收录与论文原始发表时间分别说明。
df7a1addbf168810f9e3bad437cd979a72684bf1.translation: The second recommendation shows its original 2024 date, fixed version and CC BY 4.0 license; 2026 column inclusion is distinguished from original publication.

9164077d22d7adb8252d970bbadaa81ff2ee9604.source: 在推荐阅读器点击原文、中文译文或已提供的论文解读；个人库显示本地 PDF。各文档分别保留当前模块标签内的页码，分页可能不同。
9164077d22d7adb8252d970bbadaa81ff2ee9604.translation: Choose Original, Chinese translation or available Paper commentary; personal libraries show Local PDF. Each retains its page within the current module tab, and pagination may differ.

731eb03e81b47c3169fb3bffa73c421f78810cbf.source: 在纸面区域上下滚动，连续阅读相邻页。页码随阅读位置更新，未加载的页面显示加载提示。
731eb03e81b47c3169fb3bffa73c421f78810cbf.translation: Scroll vertically across continuous pages. Page numbers update with position; unloaded pages show a loading notice.

e53ed4977a05da8f6f4054ad6f5afe55c12c058b.source: 使用左右方向键，或点击 ‹ / › 跳到上一页、下一页。也可输入页码后按 Enter 或移开焦点；页码须在显示的总页数范围内。输入框、批注编辑框和弹窗内的方向键用于编辑。
e53ed4977a05da8f6f4054ad6f5afe55c12c058b.translation: Use left/right arrows or ‹ / › for previous/next page, or enter a valid page and press Enter or leave the field. Within inputs, annotation editors and dialogs, arrows edit their contents.

ff6c31e1eed343b637b34abb9c24676c6eb0dbef.source: 在阅读缩放下拉中选择适宽，让纸面适应阅读区，或选择 25% 至 300%。在 PDF 页面上按住 Ctrl 滚动鼠标滚轮，可围绕指针位置放大或缩小；松开 Ctrl 后继续上下阅读，应用界面大小保持。放大后可横向和纵向滚动。页面会重新加载更清晰的图像，完成前保留现有画面。
ff6c31e1eed343b637b34abb9c24676c6eb0dbef.translation: Choose Fit width or 25%–300% under Reading zoom. Ctrl+wheel over the PDF zooms around the pointer; release Ctrl to scroll without changing app scale. Larger pages scroll both ways. Clearer page images load while existing images remain visible.

21c1d69bd96f30c8f1d43a024633640ac33eda77.source: 点击全屏阅读，隐藏工作台导航、论文目录和信息区，保留阅读工具与纸面。全屏中可以切换文档、选择文字和添加批注；点击退出全屏或按 Esc 返回之前的窗口状态。
21c1d69bd96f30c8f1d43a024633640ac33eda77.translation: Read fullscreen hides navigation, catalog and information but keeps reading tools/pages. Switch documents, select text or annotate there. Exit fullscreen or Esc restores the prior window.

2c8f67faedd3f4321a34110c5b0a3c93d40a1336.source: 连续阅读按阅读位置加载附近页。快速跳到远页时可能短暂等待，页面占位仍按顺序排列。跨页选择只适用于当前已加载文字层的附近页面；较长内容可以分段复制或标注。
2c8f67faedd3f4321a34110c5b0a3c93d40a1336.translation: Continuous reading loads nearby pages. Distant jumps may briefly wait, with placeholders in order. Cross-page selection uses nearby loaded text layers; copy/annotate long passages in sections.

cd76903a4efcf317815290a40a1395c98e6060df.source: 全屏阅读保留原文、中文译文、论文解读及阅读工具，点击退出全屏返回原窗口。
cd76903a4efcf317815290a40a1395c98e6060df.translation: Fullscreen keeps original, Chinese translation, commentary and reading tools; exit to restore the window.

d3f89de594e2651c4bcf0e232a5a0f9348ea41bb.source: 在 PDF 纸面文字上按住鼠标左键拖选。
d3f89de594e2651c4bcf0e232a5a0f9348ea41bb.translation: Drag with the left mouse button over PDF text.

17890aecfd3f78a7d2f16a5acb742c609b35c3fc.source: 按 Ctrl+C 直接复制，或点击复制选文。可以在相邻的已加载页面之间选择文字。
17890aecfd3f78a7d2f16a5acb742c609b35c3fc.translation: Press Ctrl+C or Copy selection. Selection can span adjacent loaded pages.

cf45b037c61274c68629421a01ea2f658b129e4b.source: 需要查看纯文本时点击本页文字，再次点击返回纸面。复制公式、音标、连字或双栏内容后，请对照原文核对字符和顺序。
cf45b037c61274c68629421a01ea2f658b129e4b.translation: Page text shows plain text; click again for the page image. Check copied equations, IPA, ligatures and two-column text against the original for characters and order.

a4bfc1da123194abf780902db2dc4bafa769c5b7.source: 选字来自 PDF 内嵌文本层。扫描图片或图内转为轮廓的文字无法直接选择，本模块不执行 OCR。所选文字可用于个人笔记，引用时仍须保留作者和出处。
a4bfc1da123194abf780902db2dc4bafa769c5b7.translation: Selection comes from embedded PDF text. Scans and outlined figure lettering cannot be selected; this module does not run OCR. Use selections for personal notes and retain authors/sources when citing.

43be351e20a35ccd994becb6fe3532ca5d518025.source: 点击阅读工具栏的批注，右侧展开批注列表。Windows 和 macOS 版显示本机批注，网页版显示个人批注。无需选中文字即可点击添加本页笔记，输入内容后选择保存批注，记录附在当前页。要标记具体文字时，再按下面的步骤选择文字、添加荧光笔或批注；全屏阅读时也可直接操作。
43be351e20a35ccd994becb6fe3532ca5d518025.translation: Click Annotations to open the sidebar. Windows/macOS shows Local annotations; web shows Personal annotations. Add page note needs no selection: type and Save annotation to attach it to the current page. For specific text, select it and follow the steps below. These tools also work fullscreen.

ab4977af38f5d0ce523e8c3e2755d1785c633da4.source: 在纸面拖选要标记的文字，工具栏会显示已选择的页数，纸面显示蓝色选区。点击颜色或标记工具时会保留本次选文。重新拖选可更换范围，点击正文空白处、跳页或切换文档可取消选文。
ab4977af38f5d0ce523e8c3e2755d1785c633da4.translation: Drag to select text. The toolbar shows selected page count and the page shows a blue selection. Color/tool clicks retain it. Drag again to replace it; blank-page clicks, page jumps or document changes clear it.

ca1267d1893c796a64e5088dafc44590923ff916.source: 选择黄色、绿色或粉色，再点击荧光笔，也可先设颜色再拖选。保存成功后，蓝色选区变为对应颜色的标记，并显示保存提示。跨页选文按页保存，同一次操作可一起撤销。点击已有荧光笔可选中它，边框和工具栏会提示已选中荧光笔，点击删除荧光笔或按 Delete、Backspace 即可删除；点击空白处可取消选中。标记上的文字仍可拖选。
ca1267d1893c796a64e5088dafc44590923ff916.translation: Choose yellow, green or pink, then Highlight; color may also be set before selecting. On success, blue selection becomes the chosen color with a save notice. Multi-page highlights save per page but undo together. Click an existing highlight to select it; the border/toolbar confirms selection. Delete highlight, Delete or Backspace removes it. Blank clicks deselect it, while text on highlights remains selectable.

e0750650dc8c2db3bf092598764b0ff57e0babf2.source: 需要说明时，在一页内选择文字，点击添加批注，在便签中写下内容后点击保存批注。便签只显示自己的批注文字，不重复展示原文。保存成功后便签关闭，纸面显示批注标记，并提示批注已保存或批注已保存到本机。取消后可以继续使用当前选文；跨页文字批注应分开添加。
e0750650dc8c2db3bf092598764b0ff57e0babf2.translation: To comment, select text within one page, click Add annotation, type in the sticky note and Save annotation. Notes show only your comment without repeating the quote. On success the note closes, a page marker appears and saving is confirmed. Cancel retains selection. Add cross-page text comments separately.

000cdc450a33187fd99d20ffefe0f460f89ea846.source: 右侧批注列表使用与标注颜色对应的便签卡片，显示页码和批注文字。点击页码可定位记录，点击编辑可修改内容，点击删除会立即删除这条标注，删错时可以撤销。点击纸面的笔形标记也能打开对应的便签。
000cdc450a33187fd99d20ffefe0f460f89ea846.translation: The annotation list uses color-matched sticky cards with page numbers and text. Click a page number to locate, Edit to change content, or Delete for immediate removal. Undo corrects mistakes. Pen markers on the page also open the matching note.

5aef8f1e2f42fd13edcf8441fbda89725f3cea73.source: 批注与荧光笔按 PDF 内容分别保存。原文、译文和解读的内容不同，记录分别使用；个人 PDF 移动位置而内容保持一致时，已有记录继续可用。Windows 和 macOS 版将记录保存在本机应用数据目录，不上传服务器；网页版将记录保存在当前账号与项目的临时工作区，需要长期保留时请导出含批注的 PDF。三端均不改动来源 PDF。每个 PDF 最多保存 1000 条批注，每条文字最多 5000 字。
5aef8f1e2f42fd13edcf8441fbda89725f3cea73.translation: Annotations/highlights are saved separately by PDF content. Original, translation and commentary have independent records. Moving unchanged personal PDFs retains annotations. Windows/macOS stores records in local app data without upload; web stores them in the current account/project's temporary workspace, so export annotated PDFs for long-term retention. No platform changes source PDFs. Each PDF supports 1000 annotations, each up to 5000 characters.

484df49dd0c1c8e685f73185f4bcd9e2565a0e14.source: 按 Ctrl+Z 撤销标注，按 Ctrl+Shift+Z 重做，也可点击工具栏的撤销与重做。macOS 同时支持 Command+Z 和 Command+Shift+Z。添加、编辑和删除荧光笔或批注都可撤销，同次跨页荧光笔作为一步。历史保留本次打开文档后的最近 100 步，切换文档或重新载入批注后重新开始。便签输入框中的快捷键用于撤销或重做正在编辑的文字，保存后才记为一次标注修改。
484df49dd0c1c8e685f73185f4bcd9e2565a0e14.translation: Ctrl+Z undoes annotations and Ctrl+Shift+Z redoes; toolbar buttons also work. macOS also accepts Command+Z/Command+Shift+Z. Add/edit/delete all support history, and one multi-page highlight counts as one step. The latest 100 steps since opening are retained; changing documents/reloading annotations resets history. Shortcuts in note inputs edit text until saving records an annotation change.

4e182788c49c6b521537d4ca6ccd6d1975f2dca4.source: 如果另一窗口修改了同一文档的批注，保存会提示冲突并保留当前输入。点击重新载入批注，核对后再保存。荧光笔保存失败时选文保留，处理提示中的问题后可再次点击荧光笔；文字批注保存失败时便签和输入保留，处理后重新保存并确认成功提示。撤销或重做也会保存实际修改，失败时处理错误提示后可继续；跨页操作部分完成时会保留已完成的结果。
4e182788c49c6b521537d4ca6ccd6d1975f2dca4.translation: Concurrent annotation changes cause a conflict while retaining input. Reload annotations, review and save again. Failed highlights retain selection; resolve the reported issue and retry. Failed text comments retain the note/input. Undo/redo saves actual changes; resolve failures before continuing, and partial multi-page completion retains completed edits.

76053a5a1537d35b25a9ff86965f5b2cb853a050.source: 选中文字添加荧光笔，右侧批注列表可定位标记；批注按文档内容保存在本机。
76053a5a1537d35b25a9ff86965f5b2cb853a050.translation: Highlight selected text and locate it in the annotation list. Annotations are stored locally by document content.

2405eaff694a2061cd08e7692f53a0bc5ae06b81.source: 导出 PDF 与批注副本

fcbe6ad848ea84019fe3c161b2a254e23e56c914.source: 点击导出 PDF，在文档下拉选择原文、中文译文、已提供的论文解读，或当前个人库的本地 PDF。
fcbe6ad848ea84019fe3c161b2a254e23e56c914.translation: Click Export PDF and select Original, Chinese translation, available commentary or the current library's local PDF under Document.

ac78efab4f725aaffcba9d54b3b569baccee0ed7.source: 只需文件时保持包含此文档的本机批注与荧光笔未勾选，导出内容与来源文件一致。需要带走阅读记录时勾选这一项。
ac78efab4f725aaffcba9d54b3b569baccee0ed7.translation: For the source file alone, leave Include local annotations and highlights unchecked. Check it to retain reading records.

38eb77314283adb8d7cc438ca699efdd21b4f3ad.source: 点击选择位置并导出，在系统保存窗口选择位置与文件名。完成后核对提示；取消保存窗口不会生成新文件。
38eb77314283adb8d7cc438ca699efdd21b4f3ad.translation: Choose location and export opens the system save dialog for a name and location. Check completion notices; cancelling creates no new file.

a28e63c12493eac1ef8e67e3c02a85d8e2e934db.source: 含批注副本保留 PDF 的文字、图片与矢量内容，荧光笔、选文批注和本页笔记采用标准 PDF 批注。导出只包含所选文档的本机记录，不把原文批注映射到译文或解读。外部阅读器的批注图标、弹窗和打印设置可能不同，分享或打印前应打开副本确认。
a28e63c12493eac1ef8e67e3c02a85d8e2e934db.translation: Annotated copies preserve PDF text, images and vectors and use standard PDF annotations for highlights, text comments and page notes. Only the selected document's local records are included, without mapping original notes to translation/commentary. Other readers may differ in icons, popups and printing; open the copy before sharing/printing.

79d4b07e3e3743e11de5934f26f7943755acdcb4.source: 导出窗口选择文档和是否包含本机批注，随后由原生窗口选择保存位置。
79d4b07e3e3743e11de5934f26f7943755acdcb4.translation: Choose the document and annotation inclusion in the export dialog, then select the destination in the native save window.

c02189559f336830e4af7e25f03630691165f3ad.source: 引用预览跟随应用字体。多作者引用按原文署名顺序生成，具体列出人数由所选引用格式决定；复制前仍应对照原论文核对作者和题名。
c02189559f336830e4af7e25f03630691165f3ad.translation: Citation previews use the app font. Author order follows the original; the chosen style determines how many are listed. Verify names/titles against the paper before copying.

cce82ab914b4498163e82a2f9aa097959d938079.source: 选中服务器推荐论文，点击紧凑题名栏右侧的引用格式。
cce82ab914b4498163e82a2f9aa097959d938079.translation: Select a recommendation and click Citation format beside the compact title bar.

2d8fc27b79236ede4f8b6c93151d15389a103bf1.source: 选择 GB/T 7714—2015、ASA（美国社会学会）、MLA 9、APA 7 或 BibTeX。
2d8fc27b79236ede4f8b6c93151d15389a103bf1.translation: Choose GB/T 7714—2015, ASA (American Sociological Association), MLA 9, APA 7 or BibTeX.

0419b85fe9d8943f62d90d72266bccdc1df93d2f.source: 检查预览中的作者、标题、年份与固定版本链接，点击复制引用，再粘贴到文档或文献管理工具。
0419b85fe9d8943f62d90d72266bccdc1df93d2f.translation: Check authors, title, year and fixed-version link; click Copy citation and paste into a document or reference manager.

c027ec55a8ee05eb8804051870f4205cd89b6e55.source: 引用指向原文固定版本，年份使用原稿日期，访问日期按当前日期生成。引用采用原论文元信息，中文译文和解读用于辅助阅读。期刊、卷期或页码按已核实信息填写。个人 PDF 没有服务器文献元信息，不提供自动引用格式。
c027ec55a8ee05eb8804051870f4205cd89b6e55.translation: Citations link the fixed original version, use the manuscript date for the year and generate today's access date. Original metadata supplies references; translation/commentary assists reading. Verified information supplies journal, volume, issue and pages. Personal PDFs lack server metadata, so automatic citation styles are unavailable.

5ca88246e1d795368bd0acc4994337d5a37f7dee.source: GB/T 选项明确采用 2015 版，学校或期刊指定其他版本时应据其要求调整。ASA 在此指美国社会学会。复制结果为纯文本，斜体、悬挂缩进与姓名拆分等仍需按投稿规范复核，BibTeX 可交给文献管理器排版。
5ca88246e1d795368bd0acc4994337d5a37f7dee.translation: GB/T explicitly uses the 2015 edition; adjust if your institution/journal requires another. ASA means American Sociological Association. Copies are plain text; verify italics, hanging indents and name parsing for submission. BibTeX can be formatted by a reference manager.

1f16ce0dc655c56d15b50ce0af75797c2b934afc.source: 选择引用格式，核对作者、固定版本与来源日期后复制。
1f16ce0dc655c56d15b50ce0af75797c2b934afc.translation: Choose a citation style, verify authors, fixed version and source date, then copy.

deaa917993521e03eebb67d75edd4bcc15736893.source: 服务器推荐的题名栏保留许可入口，展开论文信息可查看作者、原稿日期、固定版本、原文链接和翻译说明。本章两篇示例原文均采用 CC BY 4.0，翻译与导读注明来源、AI 辅助翻译或改编及审校情况。译文保留图内英文标签和参考文献条目。
deaa917993521e03eebb67d75edd4bcc15736893.translation: Recommendations retain license links beside the title. Expanded information shows authors, manuscript date, fixed version, original link and translation notes. Both example originals in this chapter use CC BY 4.0; translations/guides identify sources, AI assistance/adaptation and review. English figure labels and reference entries remain in translations.

12618b964b35eeeaa89745d55825d7768875bcd6.source: 分享原文、译文、解读或带批注副本前，查看对应文件的具体许可与第三方材料声明，保留署名、原文链接、许可和修改说明。分享时同时遵守文件许可。导入个人 PDF 后仍按原文件许可使用。
12618b964b35eeeaa89745d55825d7768875bcd6.translation: Before sharing originals, translations, commentary or annotated copies, check each file's license and third-party notices. Retain attribution, original links, license and modification notices. Personal PDFs remain subject to their original licenses.

567baccab1e7fa3a32f96f0063a68bab4ed211e2.source: 已完整获取的推荐与本地 PDF 在离线时仍可阅读、复制、批注和导出。检查失败会显示网络提示，现有有效目录与文件保留；推荐文件缺失或校验失败时需要联网重新获取。未接入论文服务的普通浏览器预览仅提示在桌面版使用。
567baccab1e7fa3a32f96f0063a68bab4ed211e2.translation: Complete recommendations and local PDFs support offline reading, copying, annotations and export. Failed checks retain valid catalogs/files with a network notice; missing or invalid recommendation files need online retrieval. Ordinary browser previews without the paper service show a desktop-use notice.

ac99f9003ed850fe9eca6071f1facc19395a7477.source: 推荐文件、首次日期、自动获取设置、推荐收藏分组与批注保存在固定用户数据目录，与启动运行缓存分开。个人 PDF 保存在自己选择的根文件夹。清除启动缓存不会清除这些文件或记录。
ac99f9003ed850fe9eca6071f1facc19395a7477.translation: Recommendation files, first-launch date, automatic-download settings, collection labels and annotations stay in a fixed user-data location separate from startup caches. Personal PDFs stay in your root folder. Clearing startup cache does not remove these records/files.

bac0203bbf18fbb5e8e5dd925a078e5a19a449d7.source: 备份个人文献时复制整个根文件夹。本机批注保存在应用数据目录中，迁移文献、清理应用数据或重装系统前，另行导出含本机批注的 PDF 副本。
bac0203bbf18fbb5e8e5dd925a078e5a19a449d7.translation: Back up personal literature by copying the entire root folder. Local annotations stay in app data; export annotated PDFs before moving libraries, clearing app data or reinstalling the system.
